name: Fresher narrates a project without naming the tech stack

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your final-year project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Sure. My capstone project was a smart attendance system for our college. I built the backend, designed the user interface, and deployed it. We tested it with about 80 students from my batch. CGPA-wise I'm at 8.2.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What was the most challenging part?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly the integration was tricky. I built the face-detection part myself and we had to make it work end-to-end. Our project was demoed at the college tech fest.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I can join from June after my semester exams end. Joining date is flexible if needed.
